entries.text: # Handover: Domaine des Trois Chênes, cellar and vineyard operations
entries.label: Handover: Domaine des Trois Chênes, cellar…

entries.text: The estate farms 18 hectares, of which 11 are Cabernet Franc and 7 Chenin Blanc, on clay and flint soils.
entries.label: The estate farms ## hectares, of…

entries.text: The 2024 harvest yielded 48,000 bottles after hail in May destroyed roughly a fifth of the crop on the western plots.
entries.label: The #### harvest yielded ##,### bottles…

entries.text: Certification is organic since 2019 and conversion to biodynamic was started in 2023; it requires three consecutive compliant years, so the earliest certification date is 2026.
entries.label: Certification is organic since #### and…

entries.text: Export accounts for 41 percent of sales, mainly to Belgium and Japan; the Japanese importer requires sulphite levels below 60 milligrams per litre.
entries.label: Export accounts for ## percent of…

entries.text: In 2022 a temperature controller in tank 4 drifted by 3 degrees for two days and the batch lost its aromatic profile; it was sold in bulk at a loss of 11,000 euros.
entries.label: In #### a temperature controller in…

entries.text: Controllers are now calibrated before each harvest and tank 4 carries a second probe.
entries.label: Controllers are now calibrated before each…

entries.text: In 2023 a label printing error sent 900 bottles with the wrong vintage to a distributor; all were recalled, and label proofs now require two signatures.
entries.label: In #### a label printing error…

entries.text: Rules in force: no irrigation on the western plots, because a 2021 trial showed it lowered acidity below the level the Japanese importer accepts.
entries.label: Rules in force: no irrigation on…

entries.text: Harvest dates are decided from sugar and acidity measurements taken on three consecutive mornings, never from the calendar.
entries.label: Harvest dates are decided from sugar…

entries.text: Any tank above 28 degrees during fermentation must be cooled within four hours.

entries.text: A move to lighter bottles was proposed in 2025 to cut carbon footprint and shipping cost, but the Japanese importer has not confirmed acceptance, and no cost comparison has been produced.

entries.text: Whether the eastern parcel should be replanted after 2027 remains undecided; the vines there are 54 years old and yields have fallen 30 percent in five years.
